metadata.question: Are there more red flowers visible on April 21, 2018, than on May 7, 2018, in Keukenhof Garden in the Netherlands?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Keukenhof Garden, Netherlands (approximately 52.27°N, 4.55°E) - Dates: April 21, 2018 and May 7, 2018 (single day snapshots) - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for flower detection) - Need to detect "red flowers" - this requires high-resolution RGB imagery 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds since we need clear view of flowers - Use SCL band or QA60 for cloud masking - Red flowers can be detected using red band dominance (red > green, red > blue) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - C1: No images found for either date - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked (clouds/no valid data) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: More red flowers on April 21 - B: More red flowers on May 7 or equal 4. Approach: - Get Sentinel-2 images for both dates (±3 days window) - Apply cloud mask - Detect red pixels: where R > G and R > B and R > threshold - Count red pixels for each date - Compare counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const keukenhof = ee.Geometry.Point([4.546, 52.270]); const roi = keukenhof.buffer(500); // 500m radius around Keukenhof const date1 = ee.Date('2018-04-21'); const date2 = ee.Date('2018-05-07'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check function maskClouds(image) { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function detectRedFlowers(image) { const red = image.select('B4'); const green = image.select('B3'); const blue = image.select('B2'); // Red flowers: R > G and R > B and R > 1500 (to avoid bare soil) const redMask = red.gt(green) .and(red.gt(blue)) .and(red.gt(1500)) .and(green.lt(2000)); // Avoid bright white/clouds return image.updateMask(redMask); } // Get images for April 21 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date1.advance(-3, 'day'), date1.advance(3, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 21 images found: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No images for April 21, 2018'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get images for May 7 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2.advance(-3, 'day'), date2.advance(3, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 7 images found: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No images for May 7, 2018'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing const img1 = maskClouds(col1.first()); const img2 = maskClouds(col2.first()); // Count valid pixels after cloud masking const validCount1 = img1.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); const validCount2 = img2.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); console.log(`April 21 valid pixels: ${validCount1}`); console.log(`May 7 valid pixels: ${validCount2}`); if (validCount1 === 0 || validCount2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Detect and count red flowers const redImg1 = detectRedFlowers(img1); const redImg2 = detectRedFlowers(img2); const redCount1 = redImg1.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); const redCount2 = redImg2.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`April 21 red flower pixels: ${redCount1}`); console.log(`May 7 red flower pixels: ${redCount2}`); if (redCount1 === null || redCount2 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (redCount1 > redCount2) { console.log('More red flowers on April 21'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('More or equal red flowers on May 7'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
